verdict.rationale: Edge0 is a local inference engine distributed via GitHub. The docs show the full self-host path: models are fetched with a script, then `edge0 serve edge0-35b` exposes an OpenAI-compatible /v1/chat/completions endpoint on 127.0.0.1. Native local apps and a daemon are listed for macOS, Windows, iOS and Android, and a single download is a ready-to-run model. Missing for 10: no explicit open-source license terms in the evidence, no independent hands-on corroboration of a self-hosted deployment.
